subject.title: fix(media): normalize case-insensitive file:// URI schemes in MEDIA directives (#103473)

question: After the parser blocker and proof gap are resolved, should maintainers repair this narrow PR or select one sibling as the sole canonical fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/103473?
rationale: Three overlapping contributor branches exist, and selecting between a parser-scoped fix and broader changes to separate local/web media APIs requires maintainer ownership judgment.

options.title: Repair this narrow PR
options.body: Update the same-parser fallback gate, add focused spaced-path coverage, require outbound proof, and then close the redundant siblings.

options.title: Adopt the broader sibling
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/103539 only after its separate local and web media changes receive contract-specific tests and proof.

options.title: Request one replacement
options.body: Pause all three branches and ask for a fresh parser-scoped, proof-positive candidate.

recommendation.title: Repair this narrow PR
recommendation.body: Update the same-parser fallback gate, add focused spaced-path coverage, require outbound proof, and then close the redundant siblings.
